mapper.sql: h.sales_order_id, h.sales_order_no, TO_CHAR(h.business_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS business_date, TO_CHAR(h.due_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS due_date, h.partner_id, p.partner_code, h.partner_name, h.warehouse_id, w.warehouse_code, h.warehouse_name, h.assignee_id, a.assignee_code, h.assignee_name, h.note, h.progress_status, h.deleted_yn, TO_CHAR(h.updated_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS updated_at
FROM SALES_ORDER h LEFT JOIN BIZ_PARTNER p ON p.partner_id = h.partner_id LEFT JOIN WAREHOUSE w ON w.warehouse_id = h.warehouse_id LEFT JOIN ASSIGNEE a ON a.assignee_id = h.assignee_id
mapper.select: SELECT l.sales_order_line_id, l.sales_order_id, l.quotation_line_id, l.item_id, i.item_code, l.item_name, l.specification, l.note, l.unit, l.unit_price, l.quantity, l.supply_amount, l.vat_amount, l.total_amount FROM SALES_ORDER_LINE l JOIN SALES_ORDER h on h.sales_order_id = l.sales_order_id LEFT JOIN item i ON i.item_id = l.item_id WHERE h.sales_order_id = #{salesOrderId} AND l.deleted_yn = 'N' AND h.deleted_yn = 'N' ORDER BY l.sales_order_line_id ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE SALES_ORDER SET business_date = TO_DATE(#{businessDate}), due_date = TO_DATE(#{dueDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD'), partner_id = #{partnerId}, partner_name = #{partnerName}, warehouse_id = #{warehouseId}, warehouse_name = #{warehouseName}, assignee_id = #{assigneeId}, assignee_name = #{assigneeName}, note = #{note}, updated_at = LOCALTIMESTAMP WHERE sales_order_id = #{salesOrderId} AND deleted_yn = 'N'

UPDATE SALES_ORDER_LINE SET quotation_line_id = #{quotationLineId}, item_id = #{itemId}, item_name = #{itemName}, specification = #{specification}, unit = #{unit}, quantity = #{quantity}, unit_price = #{unitPrice}, supply_amount = #{supplyAmount}, vat_amount = #{vatAmount}, total_amount = #{totalAmount}, note = #{note} WHERE sales_order_line_id = #{salesOrderLineId} AND sales_order_id = #{salesOrderId} AND deleted_yn = 'N'
UPDATE SALES_ORDER SET deleted_yn = 'Y' WHERE sales_order_id = #{salesOrderId} AND deleted_yn = 'N'

UPDATE SALES_ORDER_LINE SET deleted_yn = 'Y' WHERE sales_order_id = #{salesOrderId} AND deleted_yn = 'N' AND sales_order_line_id IN
#{lineId}

UPDATE SALES_ORDER_LINE SET deleted_yn = 'Y' WHERE sales_order_id = #{salesOrderId} AND deleted_yn = 'N' AND sales_order_line_id IN
